Computes a genesis file SHA-256 hash and derives a shred version from it.

# Purpose
This header defines a small inline helper, [`compute_shred_version`](<#compute_shred_version>), that reads a genesis file and computes two values from its contents. It opens the file at `genesis_path`, streams the data through `fd_sha256`, and can copy the final 32-byte SHA-256 digest into `opt_gen_hash` when that output is requested. It then derives a `ushort` shred version by XORing the 16-bit words of the hash, swapping byte order, and adding one unless the value would exceed `USHORT_MAX`. The function returns `0` on success and `-1` if file open or read fails, while also reporting close errors through `FD_LOG_ERR`.
